findings.detail: market.referenceStocks contains ticker arrays that duplicate data from src/domain/services/sectorPeers.ts:SECTOR_PEERS. All 12 sectors have identical ticker lists. When SECTOR_PEERS is updated (e.g., adding a new stock to a sector), the mcp.config.json must be manually updated as well.
findings.risk: Data drift on sector/ticker updates. Requires two-edit maintenance (sectorPeers.ts + mcp.config.json).

fixed_findings.fix_notes: Aligned default with config canonical source. Production unaffected (config always passed).
